sentences.text:
2. The claimant-injured approached the 2nd Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal (SD), Berhampur,
Ganjam under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 seeking compensation of Rs.1,50,000/-
on account of injuries sustained in a road accident owing to rash and negligent driving of offending vehicle-car bearing registration No.OD-02T-9111 by way of an application which was registered as MAC Case No.194 of 2019 (115/2019-GDC).
3.

entities.text:
2nd Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal (SD), Berhampur,
Ganjam
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Vide Judgment dated 02.01.2023, said matter got disposed of with award of compensation to the tune of Rs.40,000/- (rupees forty thousand only) with simple interest @ 6% per annum from 21.06.2019 till actual payment.
It was directed for deposit of entire awarded amount in cash.

4. With the consent of Sri Biranchi Narayan Rath, learned counsel for the Appellant and on concession of the Officers of the Insurance Company, who were present today before this Lok Adalat through virtual mode, the amount of compensation is enhanced to further consolidated sum of Rs.40,000/- (rupees Forty thousand only).
The Insurance Company is now required to deposit the said enhanced amount before the Tribunal within two months hence which shall be disbursed to the claimant by the MACT.
5. The appeal is disposed of accordingly.
